title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.6
subtitle: A cleaner Beta and Dev interface.

highlights.title: Focused Simulation UI
highlights.description: Advanced, Collision Timing and Advanced Contact Distance stay hidden in Beta and Dev builds without changing their saved values or simulation behavior.

highlights.title: Compact Preferences
highlights.description: Related viewport and bake controls are grouped into a cleaner, more compact Preferences layout.
